description: One nudge per session toward the system map before the first Grep in a mapped repository with code facts. Fails open.

args: export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS= SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=never; unset SSH_ASKPASS; p=; m=$(command -v mise 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$m" ]; then p=$(cd / && MISE_AUTO_INSTALL=0 "$m" which cartographer 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || p=; [ -x "$p" ] || p=; fi; if [ -z "$p" ]; then c=$(command -v cartographer 2>/dev/null); r=$(realpath "$c" 2>/dev/null || readlink -f "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo "$c"); case "$c|$r" in *"/mise/shims/"*|*"/mise/installs/"*) c= ;; esac; d=${MISE_DATA_DIR%/}; [ -n "$c" ] && [ -n "$d" ] && case "$c|$r" in "$d"/*|*"|$d"/*) c= ;; esac; [ -n "$c" ] && [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$c" -ef "$m" ] && c=; p=$c; fi; [ -n "$p" ] && "$p" hook grep; exit 0
